svg.title: Engagement, Reach and Reflex Attack
svg.desc: Show Grid melee and Reach square bands, what Engages, and the difference between Move and Shift when leaving an enemy's melee distance.

text.tspan: = adjacent to at least one enemy that is not Knocked

svg.text: Out. A Knocked Out combatant is never Engaged. The Party B
combatant is adjacent, so both are Engaged. The Monster is
within Reach distance but not adjacent, so it does not Engage.
Digits give the distance in squares. Tabletop Mode: melee 1",
Reach 2". Reach does not change Engagement.

text.tspan: away from the Party B combatant's melee distance: that

svg.text: combatant may spend 1 AP on a Reflex Attack (base damage
dice with Disadvantage). It resolves at the trigger point (1),
